elements.description: A quiet card of caveats and notes under a page's charts, numbered or bulleted, each with an optional link.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quiet line under the heading

properties.name: numbered
properties.description: Numbers the notes (default true); numbered="false" gives a plain bulleted list

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-navigate
events.description: A note's link was clicked ({ href, id }: FootnotesNavigate); cancelable – prevented, the link isn't followed

props.name: title
props.description: The heading ("Notes" by default), and the region's name

props.name: onNavigate
props.type: (href: string, id: string, event: CustomEvent<FootnotesNavigate>) => void
props.description: A note's link was clicked; call `event.preventDefault()` to route it yourself instead of following the link

changelog: **Footnotes:** `tc-footnotes` (`@adamstavely/trenchcoat/footnotes`, React `Footnotes`, Angular `Footnotes` from `@adamstavely/trenchcoat/angular/footnotes`), a quiet card of caveats and notes under a page's charts. - `heading` (“Notes”), `description`, `notes` (`FootnoteNote[]`: `id`, `text`, `href?`, `linkLabel?`, exported), `numbered` (true by default; `numbered="false"` gives a bulleted list) and `look`. The notes are small secondary text in the standard card shell, with a muted icon so the card sits below the charts it explains. - A note's link (its `linkLabel`, or “More”; `href` through `safeUrl`, an unsafe one dropped) fires a cancelable `tc-navigate` (`{ href, id }`: `FootnotesNavigate`) – prevented, the link isn't followed, so an app's router can take it. Modifier clicks are left to the browser. - The host is a region named by the heading. With no notes it renders nothing at all – no heading-only card, no region.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
